title.narrative: KASSALA HEALTH CITADEL. PROMOZIONE DELLA QUALITA’ DELL’OFFERTA DEI SERVIZI SANITARI – PROCASE
PROMOTING QUALITY HEALTH CARE SERVICE PROVISION IN KASSALA HEALTH CITADEL

description.narrative: L'obiettivo dell'iniziativa proposta è la realizzazione di infrastrutture fisiche per migliorare le strutture sanitarie a livello statale e locale a beneficio dei residenti e delle popolazioni migranti degli Stati del Sudan orientale. Il progetto mira a migliorare la fruizione e la qualità dei servizi sanitari e a fornire un ambiente sicuro per i pazienti e gli operatori, in particolare per i disabili, della Cittadella della Salute di Kassala. Costruzione di aree esterne, percorsi pedonali e per disabili, che collegano il reparto di chirurgia generale con la banca del sangue, la maternità, il centro diagnostico e altre strutture della Cittadella della Salute di Kassala. Completamento della fase I del nuovo reparto di chirurgia generale.

Objective of the proposed initiative is the execution of physical infrastructures to improve the health facilities at State and Locality level for the benefit of the residents and migrant populations of the Eastern Sudan States. The project is aimed to improve the uptake and quality of health care services as well as to provide a safe environment for patients and workers, especially disables, of the Kassala Health Citadel. Construct of external areas, pedestrian and disables routes, connecting the general surgical unit with blood bank, maternity hospital, diagnostic center and other facilities of Kassala Health Citadel. Completion of New General Surgical Unit Phase I.

tag.narrative: Achieve universal health coverage, including financial risk protection, access to quality essential health-care services and access to safe, effective, quality and affordable essential medicines and vaccines for all
By 2030, achieve access to adequate and equitable sanitation and hygiene for all and end open defecation, paying special attention to the needs of women and girls and those in vulnerable situations

By 2030, end preventable deaths of newborns and children under 5 years of age, with all countries aiming to reduce neonatal mortality to at least as low as 12 per 1,000 live births and under-5 mortality to at least as low as 25 per 1,000 live births

By 2030, improve water quality by reducing pollution, eliminating dumping and minimizing release of hazardous chemicals and materials, halving the proportion of untreated wastewater and substantially increasing recycling and safe reuse globally
By 2030, reduce by one third premature mortality from non-communicable diseases through prevention and treatment and promote mental health and well-being
By 2030, reduce the adverse per capita environmental impact of cities, including by paying special attention to air quality and municipal and other waste management
By 2030, reduce the global maternal mortality ratio to less than 70 per 100,000 live births
Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all
Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages
Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable
